# [C1 — Stratification strength](../hypodrafts/C1.md "Stratification strength")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_c1.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Draft, not a result.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-PRED">[C1](../hypodrafts/C1.md "Stratification strength") predicts that deficit "tracks the strength and persistence of the pycnocline, and is near zero in well-mixed water whatever the load."</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-PRED "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**Scope cut first.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-SCOPE">*Persistence* is not testable here. A cast is a snapshot, the extract holds visits rather than a continuous record, and whether a pycnocline held between visits is unobserved. What follows tests **strength only**; persistence needs a moored temperature and salinity chain for a stratified season — an instrument, not an analysis.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-SCOPE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## 1. The observable consequence

A weak consequence and a strong one, treated separately.

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-A">**C1a (gradient).** Within one station and calendar month, casts with stronger density structure have less oxygen in the bottom metre.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-A "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-B">**C1b (floor).** Well-mixed casts do not show low bottom oxygen — the strong claim, and the falsifiable one.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-B "What this claim rests on")</sup>

> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-FALSB">**Falsifies C1b:** more casts with stratification in the lowest quintile *and* low bottom oxygen than Null C allows. Then a mixed column can also run out, and "near zero in well-mixed water" is false as stated.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-FALSB "What this claim rests on")</sup>
>
> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-FALSA">**Falsifies C1a:** the association between the potential energy anomaly φ and bottom oxygen does not exceed the computed nulls of §3.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-FALSA "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**What is not the test.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-DEF">DCE call it iltsvind when the oxygen concentration in the water is below [4](../SOURCES.md#F-27c460c084) mg/l, and name stratified water as where it develops, not as part of the definition.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-DEF "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-RAW">The test uses raw per-measurement oxygen, not the published iltsvind extent: it compares casts within a station and month, and an extent mapped per survey carries neither the cast nor its density profile.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-RAW "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## 2. The data, and the circularity check

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-SRC">**Source:** `data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` ([448.7](../SOURCES.md#F-71de5ceb31) MB gzipped), one row per measurement, with `Dybde (m)` and coordinates.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-SRC "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-COUNTS">One streaming pass over the whole extract, by `scripts/hypodraft_ctd.py`, counts [152,671](../SOURCES.md#F-730bd84080) station-days — one station on one date — with both a `Temperatur` and a `Salinitet` value; [143,629](../SOURCES.md#F-1d9ced34e3) of them with at least [4](../SOURCES.md#F-6c91311fd6) depth levels of each; [133,509](../SOURCES.md#F-48d6afcb0d) of those also with an `Oxygen indhold` value in mg/l; [94,243](../SOURCES.md#F-cdf45fee97) of those joined to a recorded `BundDybde_m` in `maaledybde.csv.gz`, and [49,272](../SOURCES.md#F-1b07fcb33f) of these with a temperature profile reaching [10](../SOURCES.md#F-0e5b83c39d) m. Of all [152,671](../SOURCES.md#F-730bd84080), [139,663](../SOURCES.md#F-ca3dc46774) have their deepest <span class="chem" data-chem="O2" title="oxygen (dissolved, as a molecule)">O₂</span> within [1.5](../SOURCES.md#F-8db900747e) m of the deepest temperature or below it. They come from [1,478](../SOURCES.md#F-0a242556eb) stations, [1970](../SOURCES.md#F-cf77feeaa1) to [2026](../SOURCES.md#F-18b94da444).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-COUNTS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-MAAL">`maaledybde.csv.gz` holds [150,026](../SOURCES.md#F-8937488200) distinct station-days, [102,732](../SOURCES.md#F-f7bb7d183a) carrying `BundDybde_m`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-MAAL "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-PRIMARY">**Primary sample: the [94,243](../SOURCES.md#F-cdf45fee97) station-days with levels, oxygen and a recorded bottom depth.**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-PRIMARY "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-NOSERIES">`stations_series.bin` cannot be used: it is a monthly *median* of surface and bed separately, which breaks the pairing a cast needs.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-NOSERIES "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**Circularity.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-PHI">φ is computed from density, and density from temperature and salinity.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-PHI "What this claim rests on")</sup>

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-CIRC1">`oxysat_*` is ODA's oxygen saturation, which the national CTD method computes with temperature and salinity — two of the three inputs shared with φ. **Not used.** Only `Oxygen indhold` in mg/l.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-CIRC1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-CIRC2">Salinity is computed from conductivity and temperature, so φ rests on two sensor channels and oxygen on a third. Not circular — but φ's error and T_bed's error are correlated wherever T_bed is a covariate.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-CIRC2 "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-SALNOVA">The same method sends salinity and temperature measured on a water sample to the water-chemistry record, with the sampler given as a water bottle, not as CTD.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-SALNOVA "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-CIRC3">**The residual coupling is thermodynamic, and is the whole difficulty.** Oxygen *solubility* falls as temperature rises and depends on salinity: a warm stratified summer has high φ and low saturation concentration for reasons that are [C6](../hypodrafts/C6.md "Water temperature and solubility"), not [C1](../hypodrafts/C1.md "Stratification strength"). Not removable by a covariate; measured instead, in §3.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-CIRC3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**Error sources.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-DEPTHRES">φ depends on how finely a cast is resolved in depth: the test recomputes φ on the finest casts against decimated copies of themselves and reports the difference as a bound.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-DEPTHRES "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-PROBE">`SondeNavn` begins with the unknown-probe code `999` on [31.8](../SOURCES.md#F-0adab19bb4)% of the `Temperatur` rows ([2,384,882](../SOURCES.md#F-46b0ba5eb9) of [7,501,421](../SOURCES.md#F-0ad2b4d9e0)), [31.7](../SOURCES.md#F-9bfcad3eda)% of the `Salinitet` rows ([2,365,982](../SOURCES.md#F-38e9c5f476) of [7,474,645](../SOURCES.md#F-cf5c72a98d)), [29.8](../SOURCES.md#F-3d6cf5b1dc)% of the `Oxygen indhold` rows ([2,130,873](../SOURCES.md#F-2c1ce388eb) of [7,147,012](../SOURCES.md#F-35e37a230f)); on those rows the instrument is not recorded.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-PROBE "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-NOCLOCK">The CTD extract has no time of day, and no column for it; the water-chemistry extract does carry a clock value per sample.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-NOCLOCK "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-DIURNAL">A midday cast can carry a warm surface layer a dawn cast does not, inflating φ with no ventilation meaning: this attenuates C1a (making it conservative) and inflates the mixed set for C1b (making it anti-conservative). The CTD extract alone can neither count nor correct it; where water chemistry was sampled on the same station-day and its clock is a real time rather than a filled-in default, that clock can bound the hour.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-DIURNAL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## 3. The null — computed, never quoted

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-STAT">Statistic: **Spearman ρ between φ and bottom oxygen C_bed**, pooled over eligible casts, set against the nulls below, because zero is not the null under the constraints imposed here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-STAT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-NULLA">**Null A — the thermodynamic surrogate.** Replace each cast's observed C_bed with C_sat(T_bed, S_bed): what a fully ventilated, non-respiring column would hold. Recompute ρ. This is the association φ has with bottom oxygen under **no ventilation limitation at all**, arising purely from shared T and S — **the floor the observed ρ must beat.** Bootstrap over stations, [1,000](../SOURCES.md#F-1c219aa1c9) draws.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-NULLA "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-NULLB">**Null B — the design null.** Strata = station × calendar month × decile of recorded bottom depth. Shuffle φ within strata, recompute the *pooled* ρ, [1,000](../SOURCES.md#F-29df11a89d) times. The result is not centred on zero: it retains the between-stratum association depth, season and place produce on their own. Its distance from zero is the size of the confounding — a result worth reporting by itself.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-NULLB "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-NULLC">**Null C — for C1b.** Let *p* = the fraction of casts in the lowest φ quintile (within depth decile) whose C_bed falls below the [5](../SOURCES.md#F-6bc0341df3)th percentile of C_bed in its own station × calendar-month stratum. C1b predicts *p* near zero. Null C is *p* under the same stratified shuffle as Null B — near [0.05](../SOURCES.md#F-af0258e211), but **not assumed to be [0.05](../SOURCES.md#F-af0258e211)**: the two stratifications interact. Report the permutation distribution.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-NULLC "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## 4. Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-P1">Stream `ctd.csv.gz` once, emitting `(station, date, depth, parameter, value)` for the three parameters, with intermediates on disk; never load the archive into memory.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-P1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-P2">Keep casts with at least [4](../SOURCES.md#F-6c91311fd6) paired T/S levels, a bottom <span class="chem" data-chem="O2" title="oxygen (dissolved, as a molecule)">O₂</span> within [1.5](../SOURCES.md#F-8db900747e) m of the deepest T, and a `BundDybde_m` join. Never aggregate into water bodies — station and position are the units.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-P2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-P3">Potential density per level, under **both** `EOS-80` and `TEOS-10`, reporting the difference as a bound rather than picking one; then φ = (g/h)∫(ρ̄ − ρ(z))·z dz over the cast.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-P3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-P4">C_sat(T_bed, S_bed) for Null A. Compute the statistic and all three nulls. Report ρ **beside** Null A and Null B, never beside zero.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-P4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
5. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-P5">Report the count and station list of lowest-quintile-φ casts with C_bed below [4](../SOURCES.md#F-27c460c084) mg/l — DCE's iltsvind threshold, borrowed and flagged as such — plus the full distribution.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-P5 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## 5. What a result would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-LIC">**A positive C1a result licenses:** within a station and month, stronger density structure accompanies lower bottom oxygen by more than shared thermodynamics explains. **It does not license** causation — wind ([C2](../HYPOTHESES.md "Wind work")), bottom temperature ([C6](../hypodrafts/C6.md "Water temperature and solubility")), residence time ([C3](../HYPOTHESES.md "Residence time")) and load all covary with φ — nor anything about persistence, nor weighting a nitrogen coefficient by stratification: load is not in the CTD extract, and ODA's topic of nutrient input to the sea is not fetched.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-LIC "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-FALS">**A falsification of C1b** — hypoxic casts in well-mixed columns — is the strongest thing available here, and it is one-directional. Finding them refutes "near zero in well-mixed water whatever the load." *Not* finding them confirms nothing: where well-mixed casts are taken may keep them oxygenated for other reasons, and without a clock some casts labelled mixed may have been sampled at dawn.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-FALS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-C1-SHARE">**Nothing here licenses a share.** φ explaining variance in C_bed is a within-field statement about one of [166](../SOURCES.md#F-cf625d6012) enumerated mechanisms, not a decomposition.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-C1-SHARE "What this claim rests on")</sup>
